'''Vetro''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who sold various [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] and [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]] at [[Outpost Salara]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Vetro appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Stims vendor on Tatooine.
